title: Hallucinogens
citation: DEA, Drugs of Abuse: A DEA Resource Guide (2024 ed.), pp. 84-86
key_points: Signs: distorted sense of time, space and body; mood swings; impaired judgment; dilated pupils, higher pulse and temperature, sweating, tremors (LSD); nausea, weakness and poor coordination (psilocybin).
Possible panic, paranoia or psychosis; LSD flashbacks can occur long after use.
officer_notes: Lower stimulation, keep the person safe from injury, and request EMS if distressed.
